task_description: Summarize each dataset row into one sentence in the same language as the input. Platform feeds each CSV/JSONL row as outer_context (fields input and task; score against expected).

steps.title: Summarize paragraph
steps.aim: Produce exactly one concise sentence that captures the main idea of the source text
steps.stage_action: Read the source text from the Data section (fields input or task). Reply with a single sentence summary in the same language as the input. No markdown, no quotes, no preamble, no JSON.
steps.reasoning_questions: What is the core fact? How to express it in one short sentence?
